item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Ukraine's paradox: It can now strike further into Russia, but its heart is still dangerously vulnerable
item.description: In its 5th summer of war, Ukraine is facing a paradox: As it becomes more capable of striking deep into Russia, it's becoming less capable of protecting its own cities.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] TGH blood drone delivery program to launch in Hillsborough County
